title: sync-roms cards (cards.json): one entry per card, keyed by its folder name

device.description: A device id, or "full" for every system

size.description: The card's size as people read it, e.g. "512 GB" or "1 TB"

systems.description: System ids last picked for this card

collections.description: Ids of the user's collections synced whole to this card

frontend_collections.description: Custom collection names sync-roms wrote to the card's frontend

drivers.description: GPU driver zip names sync-roms copied to the card's Drivers folder

boot_logos.description: Boot logo file names sync-roms copied to a spruce card's App/BootLogo/Imgs

spruce_emu.description: Per ROM folder, the BIOS zip names sync-roms added to the ignoreList of the folder's Spruce Emu config
